description_excerpt: Job Description This position will be contracted through Bosch’s external vendor under a one-year agreement. Job Description The VnV Engineer creates high quality SW test specifications considering various relevant test scenarios, ensuring early defect detection in the SW development life cycle. VnV Engineer ensures test automation by writing test scripts based on the test specifications and within the defined automated test environment, ensures test execution as per test plan, documentation of defects/issues and reporting in a timely manner.
